collection.presentationOrder: randomised per pass, recorded per row
collection.rawLogs: run-logs/*.csv — one row per text per pass, with the vendor's own score field, displayed label and raw response retained verbatim

note: This cycle was collected against a corpus the operator assembled and scanned directly, so it does not use this repository's commit-reveal prompt scheme. The nonce, prompt-selection and prompt-replay checks do not apply and are skipped by verification; the manifest and score-replay checks apply as normal.
limitations: The 91 source texts were not supplied with the run logs, so samples.json carries 'not-supplied' in place of a SHA-256 and nobody can independently confirm which documents were scanned.
Ground truth (class, genre, stress profile, AI word fraction, word count) is taken from the operator's logs and cross-checked for agreement across all five files; it is not independently verified.
Five of thirteen registered detectors were measured. The other eight are absent from the leaderboard rather than scored at zero.
